message:
The target is built with MemorySanitizer (`-fsanitize=memory`). This confirms the vulnerability is a use of uninitialized data. The target is likely a fuzzer harness for poppler. Let me look for the fuzzer target:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul -name "*fuzz*" -o -name "*Fuzz*" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
